Writing Tip: Using Clauses With -ing
You can use the –ing form as a noun, an adjective or a verb.

For example:
Smoking is dangerous. (noun)
He spends his summers at a baseball training camp. (adjective)
I'm working late today. (verb)

When you use -ing as a noun, you sometimes use an article before it or sometimes you don't use it.

For example:
Editing takes a great deal of concentration.
The selling of this land signals major changes in the area.

You can also use it as a noun phrase.
For example:
Giving a speech is somewhat daunting.
Riding my bicycle to work is invigorating.

You can use the -ing form before a noun when it is an adjective.

For example:
We went to a welcoming party at the airport.
We're going to a housewarming party next week.

You use the –ing form after prepositions.

For example:
Before coming, you need to speak to Tanya.
After finding out where they were going, I decided to tag along.
I'm not looking forward to seeing the dentist.

You write informal letters to friends and family.  They often include casual language and are written more like a conversation rather than an organized piece of writing.
The most common salutation in an informal letter is Dear_____, followed by a comma.
The first part of the letter should explain to the recipient why you are writing to them.
The second part of the letter consists of the message you want to get across.

The final part of the letter is where everything is wrapped up.
Informal letters can end with a casual closing.
For example: Love, or Missing you lots,
Informal letters convey emotions and feelings unlike formal letters.  They can also include contractions and short sentences.

images.text:
Dear Beth,

How's life been treating you lately? You must be close to finishing your Law degree. I know the family is really proud of what you have achieved. Stop showing the rest of us up! Anyway, do you remember the girl I met through Margaret Vanderkamp, the matchmaker, a couple months ago? Well, she definitely has a knack for finding true love. Matchmaking is her business and I highly recommend her. She was able to connect me with the love of my life, Rhonda. She and I have been inseparable ever since our first date. She's gorgeous, talented and has a real zest for life. She laughs at my corny jokes and even thinks that my “portly” frame is adorable. Quite frankly, I am besotted with her. Don't be surprised if you get a wedding invitation in the mail before Christmas.

That being said … You and I are close, more like brother and sister than cousins. You've told me about past broken relationships and your non-existent social life. I understand that school has been your priority in the last couple years but I think it's time to turn over a new leaf. Get back in the game and start dating. Better yet, why not leave it to the experts? Living your life without someone to share it with can be lonely. Give Margaret a chance of unearthing a hidden gem for you. Before you think of dismissing my idea, why don't you give me a call and we can chat about the process.

You deserve the same happiness in your personal life.

Your cousin,

Robert
